entities.name: UniProt Q93VI8
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana Tubby-like F-box protein 7.
GO annotations include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and transcription cis-regulatory region binding.
Associated biological-process annotations include pollen development, regulation of DNA-templated transcription, and response to fungus.
Annotated locations include chloroplast, plastid, cytosol, nucleus, and plasma membrane; these annotations do not establish simultaneous localization.
Query sequence is 379 aa and contains a Tub domain (PF01167.25) at residues 105–374.
